purpose: S81-ELEM2-SEQ dsdv_seq_host_h: CLOSED lk s10hq (649101c0d) + CLOSED sq + vc views; parent of the G9 successor dsdv_seq_host_mux_h

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; dsdv_seq_host_c u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS -DOT_DSDV_SEQHOST_HARD --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_dv/unit/dsdv_seq_host_c.sv && echo lint-ok

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/dsdv_seq_host_h/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/dsdv_seq_host_h/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/dsdv_seq_host_h --out {RUN}/record/views/dsdv_seq_host_c --macro-view physical/ref_tile/dsdv_sh_lk_s10hq/views/dsdv_sh_lk --macro-view physical/ref_tile/dsdv_sh_sq/views/dsdv_sh_sq --macro-view physical/ref_tile/dsdv_sh_vc/views/dsdv_sh_vc > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

S81-ELEM2-SEQ 10-21: child view swap -- u_l0 dsdv_sh_lk = CLOSED s10hq view (job dsdv_sh_lk_s10hq-dsdv_sh_lk_s10hq-649101c0d, src 649101c0d, TT +33.16 / FF +17.42 / DRC 0, 388.8x453.6, pins = the stand-in's plan within 0.72 um; stand-in lacked s_hw_e[216]) replaces the s10f-timed DECLARED PIN STAND-IN; parent bench simulates the exact lk RTL of 649101c0d with its defines (APIPE10/S10B..S10E, TB_HSH 8) + lk mutants. Same outline/pins/placement/SDC as the S81-SEQHP gate. Prior: S81-SEQHP-1021 re-pack of dsdv_seq_host_c for the RL1 lk successor s10h (388.8x453.6, p192 masters, claude/s81-shlk-1021 @254543064): vertical stack on the 43.2 lattice, lk DECLARED PIN STAND-IN (43.2,43.2) / sq CLOSED (86.4,540.0) / vc CLOSED (86.4,734.4); 43.2 channels (lk N face -> sq S face ~1,000 nets; parent M6/M7 over the M5-capped children); outline 475.2x993.6 = S81 die seqhost slot for s10h. Parent S/W/E pins = lk faces, N pins = vc N face; ck/rst_n on E in the lk|sq channel.
